source_facts.fact: The LOCAL_DISK path groups objects by transport_endpoint and synchronously invokes local_disk_reader once per endpoint in an unordered_map loop. It is not a parallel collect-all of owner requests; the vector API returns after the loop. Actual endpoint visitation order and measured latency remain unverified.

ClientRequester configures connect_retry_count3, reconnect_wait_time1000ms, disables host-alive background reconnect and applies timeout overrides. These values alone do not establish actual per-batch duration.
invoke_rpc crosses syncAwait into an async_simple Lazy and two co_await stages. Per-owner endpoint is explicit; native logs already expose endpoints, errors and some batch IDs.
Reported batch_get_into is a synchronous vector API. The separate SHM dummy_helper posts work to a thread pool but is not established as the original report entry path.
